_template: Parent-hub leaf-aliases.json scaffold — AUTHORED and OPTIONAL for hubs. Author a row ONLY when a mode genuinely resolves a resource outside its own packet (usually into shared/); most hubs need no aliases at all, and an absent file means zero aliases. Do NOT author this on a standalone skill: there the file is a GENERATED identity projection written by ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs --fix, and hand edits are overwritten. Replace every [bracketed] placeholder and delete this wrapper object — the committed file's top level is the ARRAY below. Each diskPath must stay inside the hub root; generate-leaf-manifest.cjs merges rows into leaf-manifest.json, so regenerate the manifest after editing.
